change: Register eject in src/cli/index.ts (one line, replacing the rel-7 stub). Verb eject <name> --reason; --all; --adopt <path>; --undo; --raise '<named consumer>'; --app <root> (required when basalt.roots has 2+; else exit 1 listing roots). eject writes <root>/components/ui/<name>.tsx with header '// basalt:ejected <name>@<v> <why>', the .guard.ts, .basalt/base/<root-dashed>/<name>.tsx, a manifest.ejected row {path, fromVersion, seedDigest, reason, origin}, and a tsconfig paths row for basalt-ui/ui/<name> (JSONC-preserving, else exit 1 printing the line). seedDigest = sha256 of seed plus guard read from the tarball. Exits 1 without basalt() in that app. --adopt takes only <root>/components/ui/** files present on the merge base; a new local file needs --raise and gets origin 'local' (no base, no guard). --undo refuses uncommitted changes. budget.json changes only through --raise; eject --all without --raise exits 1. Rule: none. Skill: docs/eject.md from --help. Tests: eject.e2e, eject.roots, adopt.e2e.
